    x = float(item)
    rem = b - x

    # Match the post-placement remainder to the current slack structure of the pool.
    pool_median = np.median(b)
    pool_iqr = np.subtract(*np.percentile(b, [75, 25])) + 1.0
    slack_match = -np.abs(rem - 0.5 * pool_median) / pool_iqr

    # Reward remainders near the extremes and discourage middle residues.
    normalized = rem / (b + eps)
    edge_bias = 2.0 * np.abs(normalized - 0.5) - 1.0

    # Slightly prefer bins that are already large when the item is large.

    return 2.1 * tightness + 1.0 * slack_match + 0.7 * edge_bias + 0.25 * capacity_bias
